# Photo Albums Constitution

## Core Principles

### I. Test first
Every feature MUST ship with a failing test written before the code.

### II. Plain storage
Albums MUST be stored as plain files. No database.

## Governance
An amendment is a pull request that changes this file and bumps the version below.
